topic: In Episode 356 Hiruzen entered Root's headquarters and bargained for a single agent, Kinoe, instead of dismantling Root
title: Hiruzen Walked Into Root And Asked For One Man
description: Naruto Shippuden Episode 356 puts the Third Hokage inside Danzo's Root headquarters with every advantage. Here is what he actually asked for, and why it makes me doubt the idea that Hiruzen was simply too soft. Do you agree?
comment: Was Hiruzen bargaining because he was too soft to end Root, or because he needed it to keep existing? Pick one.

lines.text: Hiruzen walked into Root's headquarters, and he asked for one man.

shot.fallback: elderly kage entering a dark underground base

lines.text: It's Episode 356, and the Third Hokage holds every advantage.

shot.fallback: old kage with a firm expression

lines.text: Kakashi has already forced his way inside to stop Danzo from putting a cursed seal on Kinoe.

shot.search: Kakashi Danzo cursed seal Kinoe Root
shot.fallback: masked ninja bursting into a stone chamber

lines.text: Root forces are closing in around them.
Then Hiruzen himself arrives and personally authorises what Kakashi just did.

shot.fallback: kage stepping into a ring of masked agents

lines.text: Picture it: the Hokage, inside Danzo's own base, with Danzo standing right there.

shot.search: Hiruzen Danzo face to face Root base
shot.fallback: kage and bandaged elder facing off

lines.text: If you wanted Root gone, that was your moment.

shot.fallback: rows of masked agents in a dark cavern

lines.text: Instead, he negotiated Kinoe's release, and Kinoe walked out as Tenzo.

shot.search: Tenzo Kinoe released Root Team Ro
shot.fallback: agent in animal mask leaving a dark hall

lines.text: Danzo lost one agent. Root lost nothing else.

shot.fallback: bandaged elder unmoved among masked agents

lines.text: I read that as a bargain, not a defeat.

shot.fallback: two old men shaking on a quiet deal

lines.text: The best counterpoint is that Hiruzen didn't know how deep it went, but he had just walked through the front door himself.

shot.fallback: kage standing at a heavy stone door

lines.text: Whatever Hiruzen was guarding, it was worth leaving the rest of Root alone.

shot.fallback: kage staring down a long corridor

lines.text: Which brings me back to the moment he walked in and asked for one man...

shot.fallback: kage and ninja in the glow of a doorway

self_check.loop: Last line returns to the moment he walked in and asked for one man, leading into line 1.
